title: Sum a File Through mmap
prompt: POSIX. Implement `long sum_bytes_mmap(const char *path)` — open O_RDONLY, fstat for size, mmap PROT_READ MAP_PRIVATE, sum all bytes as unsigned char, munmap, close, return the sum; return -1 on any failure (open/fstat/mmap/munmap). An empty file sums to 0.

tests.name: sums the 0..255 pattern
tests.hint: The file holds sixteen 0..255 ramps: 16 times 32640 — sum 522240.

tests.name: missing file
tests.hint: A path that cannot be opened is an error, not a sum of zero.
